artifact_reasoning: Multiple moderate-to-severe artifacts are present. Text gibberish is a major failure (Severity 4) for a product shot. Structural collapse of the nozzle and melting of the cap (Severity 3) indicate poor geometric generation. General blur/compression (Severity 2) further degrades quality. While the overall silhouette is intact (supported by Topology Auditor), the local structural defects are significant. The score reflects a 'usable but flawed' generation where the object is recognizable but physically implausible in details.
